# 1. Treaty Port Concession (oneway: first = Host Port Realm, second = Concessioned Commercial Power)
oe_war2_rel_treaty_port_concession = {
	type = diplomacy
	relation_type = oneway
	uses_diplo_capacity = none
	break_on_war = yes
	annulled_by_peace_treaty = yes
	lifts_trade_protection = yes
	fleet_basing_rights = yes
	trade_to_second = 0.25
	institution_spread_to_first = monthly_institution_spread_mild
	relation_type_for_ai = friendly
	category = {
		offer = CATEGORY_ECONOMY_ACTIONS
		request = CATEGORY_ECONOMY_ACTIONS
		cancellation = CATEGORY_ECONOMY_ACTIONS
		break = CATEGORY_ECONOMY_ACTIONS
	}

	visible = {
		scope:actor = {
			has_ports = yes
			is_rebel_country = no
			within_diplomatic_range = scope:recipient
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			has_ports = yes
			is_rebel_country = no
		}
	}

	offer_enabled = {
		scope:actor = {
			num_of_ports >= 1
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				has_markets = yes
				num_of_ports >= 3
			}
		}
	}

	request_enabled = {
		scope:actor = {
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
			OR = {
				has_markets = yes
				num_of_ports >= 3
			}
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			num_of_ports >= 1
		}
	}

	offer_effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_port_host years = 20 mode = replace }
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_port_holder years = 20 mode = replace }
		}
	}

	request_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_port_host years = 20 mode = replace }
		}
		scope:actor = {
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_port_holder years = 20 mode = replace }
		}
	}

	cancel_effect = {
		scope:actor = { remove_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_port_host }
		scope:recipient = { remove_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_port_holder }
	}

	break_effect = {
		scope:actor = { remove_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_port_holder }
		scope:recipient = { remove_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_port_host }
	}

	expire_effect = {
		scope:first = { remove_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_port_host }
		scope:second = { remove_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_port_holder }
	}

	wants_to_give_diplo_chance = {
		base = -20
		actor_is_rival = -100
		positive_opinion = 0.25
		negative_opinion = -1
		trust_in_actor = 0.5
		relative_strength = 18
	}

	wants_to_receive_diplo_chance = {
		base = 18
		actor_is_rival = -100
		positive_opinion = 0.2
		negative_opinion = -0.5
	}
}

# 2. Military Advisory Mission (oneway: first = Advisory Sender, second = Host Army)
oe_war2_rel_military_advisory = {
	type = diplomacy
	relation_type = oneway
	uses_diplo_capacity = none
	break_on_war = yes
	annulled_by_peace_treaty = yes
	military_access = yes
	institution_spread_to_second = monthly_institution_spread_mild
	favors_to_first = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_WAR2_ADVISORY_FAVORS_BASE"
			value = 0.15
		}
	}
	relation_type_for_ai = friendly
	category = {
		offer = CATEGORY_MILITARY_ACTIONS
		request = CATEGORY_MILITARY_ACTIONS
		cancellation = CATEGORY_MILITARY_ACTIONS
		break = CATEGORY_MILITARY_ACTIONS
	}

	visible = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			within_diplomatic_range = scope:recipient
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			is_rebel_country = no
		}
	}

	offer_enabled = {
		scope:actor = {
			army_tradition >= 20
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
			NOT = { is_rival_of = scope:recipient }
		}
	}

	request_enabled = {
		scope:actor = {
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
			NOT = { is_rival_of = scope:recipient }
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			army_tradition >= 20
		}
	}

	offer_effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_advisor_sender years = 20 mode = replace }
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_advisor_host years = 20 mode = replace }
		}
	}

	request_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_advisor_sender years = 20 mode = replace }
		}
		scope:actor = {
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_advisor_host years = 20 mode = replace }
		}
	}

	cancel_effect = {
		scope:actor = { remove_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_advisor_sender }
		scope:recipient = { remove_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_advisor_host }
	}

	break_effect = {
		scope:actor = { remove_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_advisor_host }
		scope:recipient = { remove_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_advisor_sender }
	}

	expire_effect = {
		scope:first = { remove_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_advisor_sender }
		scope:second = { remove_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_advisor_host }
	}

	wants_to_give_diplo_chance = {
		base = -10
		actor_is_rival = -100
		positive_opinion = 0.3
		negative_opinion = -1
		trust_in_actor = 0.5
		same_international_organization = 10
	}

	wants_to_receive_diplo_chance = {
		base = 12
		actor_is_rival = -100
		positive_opinion = 0.25
		negative_opinion = -0.8
	}
}

# 3. Mutual Grain & Rail Pact (mutual: continental food security & overland transit partnership)
oe_war2_rel_grain_rail_pact = {
	type = diplomacy
	relation_type = mutual
	uses_diplo_capacity = none
	break_on_war = yes
	annulled_by_peace_treaty = yes
	food_access = yes
	lifts_trade_protection = yes
	trade_to_first = 0.15
	trade_to_second = 0.15
	relation_type_for_ai = friendly
	show_break_alert = yes
	category = {
		offer = CATEGORY_ECONOMY_ACTIONS
		request = CATEGORY_ECONOMY_ACTIONS
		cancellation = CATEGORY_ECONOMY_ACTIONS
		break = CATEGORY_ECONOMY_ACTIONS
	}

	visible = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			within_diplomatic_range = scope:recipient
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			is_rebel_country = no
		}
	}

	request_visible = { always = no }
	break_visible = { always = no }

	offer_enabled = {
		scope:actor = {
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
			NOT = { is_rival_of = scope:recipient }
		}
	}

	cancel_enabled = {
		scope:actor = {
			NOT = { is_fighting_war_together_with = scope:recipient }
		}
	}

	offer_effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_grain_rail years = 20 mode = replace }
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_grain_rail years = 20 mode = replace }
		}
	}

	offer_declined_effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:recipient modifier = opinion_decline_oe_war2_rel_grain_rail_pact }
		}
	}

	cancel_effect = {
		scope:actor = { remove_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_grain_rail }
		scope:recipient = { remove_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_grain_rail }
	}

	break_effect = {
		scope:actor = { remove_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_grain_rail }
		scope:recipient = { remove_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_grain_rail }
	}

	expire_effect = {
		scope:first = { remove_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_grain_rail }
		scope:second = { remove_country_modifier = oe_war2_mod_rel_grain_rail }
	}

	wants_to_give_diplo_chance = {
		base = -12
		actor_is_rival = -100
		positive_opinion = 0.35
		negative_opinion = -1
		trust_in_actor = 0.5
		same_religion = 8
		same_international_organization = 10
	}

	wants_to_keep_diplo_chance = {
		base = 10
		recipient_is_rival = -100
		trust_in_recipient = 0.4
		same_international_organization = 10
	}
}
